text.text_excerpt: We just visited this hotel for the weekend and it was absolutely amazing. We walked in to check in at the front desk and receive drinks while we were checking in. Then headed up to our room and we were amazed by the Decour that the room had. This is my new favorite hotel. The staff was very nice they suggested plenty of places to go eat that are close to the hotel. Kisha Washington was our event coordinator and she helped plan everything. It was a couples weekend that was absolutely spectacular. Thank you to her, the staff and the bartenders for such an amazing weekend. We will definitely be back and can't wait to see the hotel again thank you. FYI they have great food selections, Foos ba...

This place is sooo dope! The finishing's inside are so chic and so different than any other hotel I have stayed at. They have a bar that never closes! Dangerous but so good! They give you a complimentary drink upon check in and it was AMAZING! So amazing we went back after dropping our bags off for 3 more lol I didn't even know Marriott had this extension. They even have an ironing room! I can't wait to come back.

Let me start by saying this hotel's vibe is awesome! Great location ... great beds... great overhead shower... pretty much everything was fantastic... IF... I was not staying for a business trip. The hotel was so cool and fun, it was hard to keep work on my mind. The biggest pain in the butt was that there were no ironing boards in the rooms. You must use a communal ironing room... which didn't work out great for me because I typically iron my clothes for work in the morning after I shower... naked... that obviously wasn't going to happen.
